editorial_thesis: Durable agent systems are converging on structured context, task-scoped identity, and replaceable model workers; keep evidence, permissions, and event history in the control plane.

topic_groups.title: Institutional Memory + Context Graphs
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A fresh enterprise pattern turns memory from chat history into cited, queryable business structure—an under-covered bridge between knowledge management and agent reliability.

sources.title: V7 gives AI agents institutional memory
sources.why_selected: V7 Go extracts entities, relationships, facts, and citations from enterprise files into a Context Graph, with RAG as fallback.
sources.usefulness: Prototype a source-linked artifact graph for client dossiers; every answer points back to the file or record that supports it.

sources.title: Context editing + memory tool
sources.why_selected: Anthropic separates active context cleanup from durable, developer-managed memory files.
sources.usefulness: Use a two-tier memory policy: short-lived run state plus reviewed durable notes for decisions and constraints.

sources.title: Externalization in LLM Agents
sources.why_selected: The review frames memory, skills, and interaction protocols as capabilities that should be externalized rather than rediscovered inside weights.
sources.usefulness: Use it to separate Buildn “skills” from memory and tool permissions, making each versionable and testable.

sources.title: Now everyone can put data to work
sources.why_selected: OpenAI’s data-workflow direction reinforces that connecting enterprise data to repeatable workflows is the practical frontier.
sources.usefulness: Offer a client discovery sprint that inventories data sources, joins, permissions, and the first evidence-backed workflow.

sources.title: How V7 exposes context through MCP
sources.why_selected: V7 makes graph querying and workflow creation available through MCP in ChatGPT and Codex.
sources.usefulness: Use MCP as the thin interaction layer while keeping graph storage, citations, and policy inside Buildn-owned services.

topic_groups.title: Agent Security + Identity Operations
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh enterprise controls are moving from generic “AI security” toward inventories, scopes, last-used evidence, and explicit response paths—high practical leverage for client-safe agents.

sources.title: GitHub credential inventory exports
sources.why_selected: Enterprise owners can export SSH keys, PATs, OAuth tokens, and GitHub App tokens with scope, age, expiry, last-used, and target metadata.
sources.usefulness: Build a credential exposure report that ranks stale, broad, and unobserved access before an incident.

sources.title: Remote MCP clients with auth and namespacing
sources.why_selected: Cloudflare’s Agents SDK adds remote MCP clients, per-server auth, capability discovery, reconnection, and namespacing.
sources.usefulness: Borrow the per-server consent and namespacing model for Buildn worker tools.

sources.title: Agent Access Model
sources.why_selected: Cloudflare’s task-scoped architecture emphasizes identity brokering, continuous mediation, and stateful trust for agents.
sources.usefulness: Use task-scoped grants for high-impact client workflows instead of long-lived role access.

sources.title: GitHub enterprise credential inventory API
sources.why_selected: The REST endpoint turns credential visibility into an automatable feed rather than a dashboard-only exercise.
sources.usefulness: Use the API as a source for a normalized access graph and remediation workflows.

topic_groups.title: Agent Runtime + Model Portability
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The latest developer signal is a separation of control plane from model choice: multiple providers, gradual rollouts, durable state, and explicit cost/quality policy are becoming normal operating requirements.

sources.title: Grok 4.7 in GitHub Copilot
sources.why_selected: Grok 4.7 is rolling out across IDEs, CLI, cloud agent, and enterprise plans with administrator model policy controls.
sources.usefulness: Use a model bake-off harness for coding tasks, measuring completion, review findings, latency, and cost—not vibes.

sources.title: Agents API: durable sessions and environments
sources.why_selected: OpenAI’s Agents API packages agents, environments, sessions, tools, subagents, and events as runtime primitives.
sources.usefulness: Use the vocabulary to design Buildn job state and recovery without coupling the evidence model to one provider.

sources.title: MCP + Durable Objects + Workflows
sources.why_selected: The same platform combines remote MCP, hibernating stateful servers, durable objects, and long-running workflows.
sources.usefulness: Use it as a reference architecture for low-idle-cost, resumable agent jobs with explicit external calls.

sources.title: OpenAI: connecting AI usage to business value
sources.why_selected: The operator question is shifting from model usage to measurable business outcomes.
sources.usefulness: Tie runtime experiments to task-level outcomes, cycle time, error rate, and review burden.
